name: AgentMeter-Gov Guard
description: Full-chain AgentMeter-Gov guard for input, tools, output, memory, subagents and audit.

gateTimeoutMs.description: Total gate request deadline including response decoding and optional backend recovery. Expiration follows failClosed; ambiguous failures are never automatically replayed.

apiToken.description: Bearer token for an authenticated AgentMeter-Gov API.

runtimeDir.description: AgentMeter-Gov runtime root. Relative record, approval and state paths are resolved from this directory. It can also be provided by AGENTMETER_GOV_HOME.

autoStartBackend.description: Start the local AgentMeter-Gov Python backend when the OpenClaw Gateway starts.

backendRoot.description: Optional backend runtime directory. Defaults to runtimeDir or AGENTMETER_GOV_HOME.

backendPython.description: Python executable used to start server.py. Defaults to AGENTMETER_PYTHON, python on Windows, or python3 elsewhere.

backendExecutable.description: Packaged AgentMeter-Gov backend executable. When set, it is started directly and Python is not required on the target computer.

backendServerPath.description: Absolute path or backendRoot-relative path to the AgentMeter-Gov server entrypoint.

backendHealthUrl.description: Health endpoint used for reuse and readiness checks. Defaults to /health on gateUrl origin.

stopBackendOnGatewayExit.description: Stop only the backend process launched by this Gateway when the Gateway exits.

outputMaxFileBytes.description: Maximum local text attachment size inspected by the output gate. Oversized files are blocked when failClosed is enabled.

maxToolCallsPerTurn.description: Stop excessive tool loops after this many calls in one turn.

maxSearchCallsPerTurn.description: Maximum search/find/query calls in one turn.

maxIdenticalToolCallsPerTurn.description: Maximum identical tool calls in one turn before stopping a retry loop.
